wasp_selection: Two training sources only; one warmup, one solve per setting/source, repeat top two once on both sources; freeze geometric mean of per-source medians. Bounded grid, not a global optimum.
timing: Four held-out sources, one warmup and three measured repetitions per arm/source, randomized within repetition. Solve-only timers; every launch and repetition retained.
interpretation: This is an ACIC/Wasp comparison and inactive-path regression check. RMAT uses the nonshared lazy-heavy path; private chunks and shared-heap slice are inactive. No chunk optimization gain may be claimed.
validation: Full independent reference digest, correct lazy/hint/share modes, old scheduler startup and every PE affinity. Stop on any invalid launch. Non-lazy edge-ledger formula is not applicable to RMAT; no edge-attempt estimate from that formula.
scope: One exclusive Delta cpu-interactive node,128 cores, at most one node active. Current binary is frozen road-study build551571d; original is the matching earlier baseline. No solver/runtime rebuild or defaults changed.
